title: 019 全人类的进化020 天地兼修
content_zh:
江水日复一日地涨落，就如这座在全球神异时代后仍拥有千万人口的江城，人潮也从未停歇。
邻近汉江的码头旁，一艘货船的船舱深处，数道身影隐于黑暗，低声交谈。
“东西已经被神异司彻底关押了。”
一人嗓音沙哑道。
另一人冷哼：“子器明明已经成形……最后却不见了。”
“有从岳山城追来的那个周扒皮死咬着，我不好直接窥探。”
先前那人语气阴沉，“子器不会凭空消失，很可能是化为诅咒……附在某个低序列的人身上，被带出去了。”
“母器拿不回来，子器……效果也勉强接近，够用，必须找到。”
第三道声音接过话，语气透着不甘与算计，“先把那几个掺和进来的低序列盯紧。
子器肯定还在他们中间……找出来，将来未必就没有机会。”
黑暗里，几双眼睛同时闪过幽光，随着一道船只的汽笛声响起，很快消失。
...
明江小区。
许临东回到家，推开家门，便看到阿姨周惠正在厨房忙碌。
易叔正在看电视新闻，闻声从沙发上扭头。
“东子回来了？”
易国强激动走过来，上下仔细打量许临东，见其没受伤才松口气，“听你浔姐提了一嘴，说你们昨天出任务，好像还发生了交火？严不严重？”
许临东心里微微一松，看来浔姐只是略提了一嘴，没把青龙寺那番凶险全盘托出，让家里担心。
他换上拖鞋，把装着药剂和晋升文件的袋子往桌上一放，语气轻松回应：“易叔，放心，我好着呢。
昨天战斗的时候，都是卢队和队里的前辈们顶在前面，我没怎么出力，就是跟着混了点功劳。”

易千浔正在屋内床上躺着，嘴里叼着根棒棒糖，手指飞快地搓着掌机屏幕。
听见外头对话，立即把掌机往旁边一丢，趿拉着拖鞋走了过来，同时递给许临东一个心照不宣的眼神。
易国强脸上的紧张稍缓，却仍带着一丝狐疑：“这么容易就能立功升职吗？”
他看了看许临东，见其确实没受伤，终是放下心来，摆摆手，“算了，你平安回来就行。
具体的事，你们工作上的规矩我知道，也不多问了。”
许临东心里一暖，点点头，将自己已经升职的事情告知给易国强。
“易叔，我晋升成二级执行官后，每月工资、津贴和资源配额都会上调，到时家里的经济压力可以缓一缓，贷款也能更快还清了。”
易国强看着眼前挺拔精神的许临东，欣慰道：“咱们东子是越来越出息了。
不过家里的债你不用太急，易叔我还有退休金，慢慢还总还得上。”
“浔姐接下来也要晋升序列超凡者，少不了用钱的地方。”
许临东摇头，语气认真，“我能多出一份力，总是好事。”
“你还是照顾好自己吧。”
这时，周惠端着果盘从厨房走出来，关切笑道，“我刚刚在厨房就听见声音……你是升职了？我昨天好像听你姐提......”
她话未说完，易千浔已抢先一步，一把拉住许临东胳膊就往自己房间拽。
“哎呀妈，东子刚下班，让他放松一下嘛。”
content_en:
The river rises and falls day after day, just like this river city that still has a population of tens of millions after the global magical era, the crowds never stop.
Next to the dock near the Han River, deep in the cabin of a cargo ship, several figures were hidden in the darkness, talking in low voices.
"The thing has been completely imprisoned by the Department of Mysteries."
One person said with a hoarse voice.
Another person snorted coldly: "The weapon was clearly in shape...but it disappeared in the end."
"Zhou Bapi, who is chasing after him from Yueshan City, is biting him, so I can't pry directly."
The man from before said in a gloomy tone, "The weapon will not disappear out of thin air. It is most likely turned into a curse... attached to a low-sequence person and taken out."
"You can't get the mother weapon back, and the child weapon... the effect is barely close to it. It's enough. You must find it."
A third voice took over, with a tone full of unwillingness and calculation, "First keep an eye on those low-sequence people who got involved.
The Ziqi must still be among them... If he finds it, there may not be no chance in the future. "
In the darkness, several pairs of eyes flashed with light at the same time, and soon disappeared as a ship's whistle sounded.
...
Mingjiang Community.
When Xu Lindong returned home, he opened the door and saw his aunt Zhou Hui busy in the kitchen.
Uncle Yi was watching the news on TV and turned his head from the sofa when he heard the sound.
"Dongzi is back?"
Yi Guoqiang came over excitedly and looked Xu Lindong up and down carefully. He was relieved when he saw that he was not injured. "I heard that Sister Xun mentioned that you were on a mission yesterday and there seemed to be a firefight? Is it serious?"
Xu Lindong felt slightly relieved. It seemed that Sister Xun had only mentioned it briefly and did not reveal all the dangers in Qinglong Temple to make the family worry.
He put on his slippers, put the bag containing the medicine and promotion documents on the table, and responded in a relaxed tone: "Uncle Yi, don't worry, I'm fine.
During the battle yesterday, Team Lu and the seniors in the team were in front. I didn’t contribute much, I just took some credit. "
Yi Qianxun was lying on the bed in the house, holding a lollipop in his mouth and rubbing the screen of his handheld device quickly with his fingers.
Hearing the conversation outside, he immediately threw the phone aside, pulled on his slippers and walked over, while giving Xu Lindong a knowing look.
The tension on Yi Guoqiang's face eased slightly, but there was still a trace of suspicion: "Is it so easy to get promoted for meritorious service?"
He looked at Xu Lindong and saw that he was indeed uninjured. He finally felt relieved and waved his hand, "Forget it, just come back safely.
Regarding specific matters, I know your work rules, so I won’t ask any more questions. "
Xu Lindong felt warm, nodded, and informed Yi Guoqiang that he had been promoted.
"Uncle Yi, after I am promoted to a second-level executive officer, my monthly salary, allowances and resource quotas will be increased. By then, the financial pressure on my family will be relieved, and the loan will be paid off faster."
Yi Guoqiang looked at the upright and energetic Xu Lindong in front of him and said happily: "Our boss is becoming more and more promising.
But you don’t have to be too anxious about the debt at home. Uncle Yi still has a pension, so I can pay it off slowly. "
"Sister Xun will also be promoted to Sequence Transcendent next, and money will inevitably be used."
Xu Lindong shook his head and said in a serious tone, "It's always a good thing if I can do more."
"You'd better take care of yourself."
At this time, Zhou Hui walked out of the kitchen with a fruit plate and said with a concerned smile, "I heard a sound just now in the kitchen... Have you been promoted? I seemed to have heard your sister mention it yesterday..."
Before she finished speaking, Yi Qianxun had already taken the lead, grabbed Xu Lindong's arm and dragged him to his room.
"Oh mom, Dongzi just got off work, let him relax."
